reader.self_description: Claude (Opus 5.5) subagent acting as review reader RV10; read every claim excerpt on all nine pages as printed from review-queue.json (700-char statements), without opening full deposits; retitled one page and made one split.

pages.title: Function, not biography: the Paul function and the Johannine aperture function
pages.description: Four historical theses from Revelation First and The Feist Source read named scriptural figures as author-functions rather than biographical individuals. Paul is set out as the adversarial probe a heteronymic mystery system generates against its own indeterminacy, and the Baptist, Evangelist, Elder and Revelator as differentiated positions within one Johannine aperture-function. The Feist Source extends the reading to the Logos, resolved by its archive into the biography of Jesus, and an AI Overview capture in the Capture Registry is read as carrying the Paul function at its sharpest.
pages.note: Strays that share no subject with the page: PRED-267.H1 (strawberry diagnostic, function-calling architectures) and PRED-631.H1 (Operative Feminism, women as semantic substrate). The page keeps 5 on-subject claims plus these 2, so it falls under the 6-claim floor for its subject alone; a later pass could merge it into a Revelation First page.

pages.title: Zenodo's removal of 19 June 2026: the record, the mint and the removal census
pages.description: Priority records, forecasts and standing claims documenting the 19 June 2026 removal of the account and records from Zenodo, from GitHub issue #2606 and the reconstructed final-week timeline to the 666 counter image posted on 15 June. Diagnostic Seigniorage III forecasts further account-level removals under the 'verifiable research basis' category with no named decision-maker, the Verifiable Research Basis standard proposes re-auditing the gathered removal cases, and the Platform Erosion Observatory measures Zenodo's removal population and its tombstone ceiling. The page also carries the OpenAIRE moderation-mirror exchange, the Obelus and the Tombstone on Zenodotus, and the source-mapped account of Zenodo's moderation architecture.
pages.note: Strays: PRED-293.H1 (Acanthian Dove, PGM hapax legomena), PRED-593.E2 (paired-inversion room laws for platforms) and PRED-699.F3 (Profile Integrity Guardian scanning Scholar, ORCID and Zenodo) do not concern the Zenodo removal. PRED-1068.H1 (Zenodotus) and PRED-1039.H1 (the discipline's Socratic lineage) are on-page through their deposits' subject.

pages.title: One corpus divided by name: Plato, Aristotle, Theophrastus and the divided mind
pages.description: Historical theses from Many and One, the authorship notebook and The First Draft holding that the Platonic, Aristotelian and Theophrastan corpora are one body divided by name, and that the divisions are editorial: Andronicus's genuine/spurious partition and his πίνακες, and the single lot of books sold to Apellicon. The page reads ancient legitimacy as standing rather than paternity and sets the esoteric/exoteric partition as an Alexander story told at the seam where corpus meets empire. What Syllogizing Can Divide names the production model as one self-dividing maker, dividing the corpus where De anima III.5 divides mind, and leaves open tests on the ghost catalogues and on epigraphic items not yet held.
pages.note: Strays with no division-by-name subject: PRED-106.H3 (semantic physics exact-name priority), PRED-197.H4 (Diagnostic Seigniorage, 'narcissist'), PRED-3.G15 (Capture Registry, defensive clauses selected as snippets), PRED-921.G1 (research basis, corpus-level misclassification) and PRED-861.H5 (Second Crucifixion, Alexander and the inverted word). Boundary with P150/P152 as in the naming note.

pages.title: Directional assimilation in accelerator anomaly classifiers: the ACRB hypotheses
pages.description: The Accelerator Classifier Retention Battery sets out seven standing hypotheses on directional assimilation in learned anomaly selection: reconstruction-specific failure, cross-family persistence, the normalized-autoencoder remedy, the low-complexity blind spot, blind-spot inheritance through distillation, drift under quantization and firmware, and the value of architectural plurality. Inversion Battery v0.2 reports that only 36 to 47 percent of a teacher's top one percent survives into the student's, with the loss in distillation, that architecture changes the orientation of the blind spot, and what is deferred to v0.3. The priors paper and the OAR protocol name the program's contribution and its pre-registered class-conditional inversion battery at matched background acceptance. The common experiment proposed is to calibrate each model at matched operating points and measure how much of a withheld class is assimilated as ordinary.
pages.note: Strays: PRED-773.G1 (quantization seam between DSL and the deviation family), PRED-1067.H2 (Phase X historical suppression hypothesis), PRED-1570.H18 (Caeiro's terms absent from Caeiro; belongs with the authorship pages) and PRED-1664.G1 (Negative of the Negative v2 admission hypothesis). PRED-931.F1 and PRED-1449.D1 (the collider inversion battery) are on-subject.

pages.title: The Negative of the Negative: owed controls, tied/untied pairs and open passes
pages.description: Unbuilt tests and standing claims from The Negative of the Negative (v1 and v2) name the controls and runs the scope model still owes: the matched-entity and absent-lineage controls, the tied/untied address pair as the dataset's instrument, the frozen panel, the naive and control arms, the unread candidate sets and the reproducibility runs. The v1 paper states seven discriminating consequences of the scope and the counterfactual at source-absent addresses that would establish its cause. Beside them sit the Capture Registry's unrun tied condition and unseated untied arms, the source-admission pair rule, and the self-audit module's EC matched-pair instrument with its preregistered null.

split.title: Sappho 31 in Philo: the blind-reconstruction program and its owed runs
split.description: The Signature Without the Name sets out a blind-reconstruction program for Sappho 31 in Philo of Alexandria and lists the runs it owes. Six unbuilt tests name the perturbation run, the specificity control, operator ablation with an Operator Necessity Index, known-direct and known-unrelated calibration pairs, a v4 spec re-run, and a Symposium run whose predictions must be registered before it is run. The continuity tether records that the program's keys and rubrics are held in a private counterpart so that predictions precede the runs.

pages.note: Split off the Sappho 31 in Philo blind-reconstruction program (6 claims). Single owed runs from unrelated works remain as strays: PRED-949.G1 (Mandala tail renewal), PRED-1046.F6 (TACHYON probe pacing), PRED-3.F2 (Zenodo host re-run), PRED-1544.F1 (writer-side contrast battery), PRED-1569.F16 (an analytics count), PRED-1632.F2 (address-string count), PRED-1655.F1 (King of AEO matched observations), PRED-1678.F4 (Living Academy benchmarks) and PRED-1679.F1 (Arch-Philosopher reading order). Unrelated strays: PRED-1490.A1 (Hunter Biden presidency forecast) and PRED-1631.G8 (Monetary Dark Matter remedy claim; belongs on P153).

pages.title: Plato–Aristotle authorship: measures, controls and pre-registered predictions
pages.description: The Measurement Register, the frozen pre-registrations and the authorship notebook set out what the Plato–Aristotle investigation measured and predicted: Aristotle completing executions Plato abandoned, his charges against Plato naming properties of his own corpus, the copy and assay vocabulary, and Aristotle as compiler of the record. Forecasts and unbuilt tests require labelled controls (the Attic orators, Albert→Aquinas, Sappho→Catullus) before the target is scored, and the ghost catalogues are read as one filing operation seen from two sides. The page states the strong claim, that Plato is Aristotle's heteronym, beside the ledger's graded standings, which hold one historical hand as live and not established.
pages.note: Strays: PRED-312.H2 (Dialectic Is Now a Machine, Gnostic darkness as system) and PRED-864.H5 (Drain Hypothesis, Critias desiccation). The Theophrastus claims PRED-1570.H12, PRED-1586.H2, PRED-1587.H1, PRED-1589.H11, PRED-1594.F10, PRED-1594.F11 and PRED-1671.H2 sit closer to P147/P152 than to the Plato-Aristotle measures; too few and too mixed to split.

pages.title: Stylometry's limits and unrun base rates in the authorship investigation
pages.description: Standing claims from the authorship investigation set limits on what stylometry can show: genre separates more strongly than authorship, separability is not identity (Chatterton as Rowley separates from Chatterton as himself), and no measured property recovers master-student succession from heteronymic construction. Unbuilt tests list the base rates and runs still owed, among them residual-vs-total parity, comparanda for terminal aporia, the Pessoa leave-one-out folds, work-level and register-conditioned runs on Aristotle and Theophrastus. Frozen predictions order speaker tightness by constraint severity and distinguish engineered from natural ambiguity, beside readings of the Statesman's open genus and Plato's coin figure.
pages.note: PRED-1560.H1 (EA-CORPORA-05 seating of Browning, Pound, Pessoa) and PRED-1571.H3 (Lee's verbatim frame) are context rather than limits or base rates but stay. Philological theses PRED-1569.H1, H3, H16 and PRED-1570.H15 could sit with P150, as the naming note says.

pages.title: Theophrastus as first draft: the seams with Λ, the Ethics and De anima
pages.description: The First Draft and Aristotelian or Theophrastan read Theophrastus's Metaphysics fragment as the continuation of Λ, divided from it by name at the hinge where the account passes from complete to needing more. Forecasts state what each seam should show: Λ answering the fragment's aporiai, the Ethics' types containing the Characters' sketches plus the frame, De anima subordinating the De sensibus survey, and HP sharing HA's connective repertoire in a less varied form. The theses read the Theophrastan function as one operation at two scales and hold that the you of the Elenchi is the I of the fragment, so the corpus contains its own reception.
pages.note: Coherent after the move; PRED-921.G6 fits through 'A corpus generates its own reception'. PRED-1585.A1, PRED-1589.A1 and PRED-1594.A1-A3 restate the same seam predictions across notebook versions.

pages.title: Money as a transmission channel: what the money-form cannot carry
pages.description: Standing claims from the September 2026 semantic-economy papers hold that what money cannot carry loses power over the account, that a monetary scalar cannot preserve a prohibition on its own equivalence, and that the native monetary form preserves only properties invariant under substitution. Mammonic Transmission Engineering forecasts that the 2026 signature inscription will transmit as a security mark and not as a name. Monetary Dark Matter states regime conditions with falsifiers: obligating provenance lowering value in some extraction regimes, and universal inscription turning a flight to quality within a currency into a flight out of it.
pages.note: Stray: PRED-957.E1 (Decrepit Memoir, 2014, 'robot money') has no money-form subject beyond the word. PRED-1631.G8 on P149 belongs here.
